title: Chalet Bellevue - Courchevel
name: Chalet Bellevue
tagline: Ever popular chalet apartment for four with stunning views
paras: Chalet Bellevue is forever busy with repeat guests - always a good sign! Part of a stylish and modern development located right in the centre of Courchevel Moriond, Bellevue is a mere 3-minute walk to the pistes, and even closer to the main shops and bars .

Chalet Bellevue has two bedrooms and two bathrooms and sleeps four guests. The two bedrooms are stylishly decorated and have en-suite facilities. The master bedroom has a bath/shower, WC and basin plus a terrace. The second bedroom has an ensuite shower, WC and basin.

The lounge and dining areas are bright, spacious and airy and are beautifully finished in contemporary style. Through the large French windows, there is direct access to the huge terrace with magnificent views for which this chalet was named.

This is the best venue for watching the numerous fireworks displays throughout the season in Courchevel. You could also watch the World Slalom Championships, followed by beautiful sunsets over the valley below.
La Terrasse, which also sleeps four guests, is in the same development.
As this chalet has a smart TV, you can enjoy your favourite shows by simply logging in to your streaming app of choice and clicking play!

title: Chalet Caribou - Courchevel
name: Chalet Caribou
tagline: Caribou sleeps 6 guests and has just completed a marvellous upgrade
paras: Chalet Caribou already had it all...terrific location, spacious ensuite bedrooms, comfortable and welcoming lounge and dining areas and fantastic sunsets. And now there's a seriously cool new kitchen with granite work surfaces, the biggest fridge in Courchevel, a whole host of fancy ovens and, crucially, a wine fridge.
Add to this that the friendly owner Olivier and his charming family live next door and Caribou is the ideal chalet. Olivier even hand crafted the dining and coffee tables himself!

Caribou's lounge now has a wonderful new wooden floor to complement the recently reworked stone fireplace. There's even comfy new furniture too. The views from the lounge are stunning, particularly for sunsets and firework displays.

Each of the generously sized bedrooms has a bath, shower, basin and wc and two of them also have West facing balconies. Guests can also enjoy private use of the Turkish style steam room on the lower ground floor.
Located just two minutes' walk up to the lift station from the old village of Courchevel Moriond, Chalet Caribou has been one of our most popular chalets for years and looks set to continue that way.

Eagle's Nest is finished in a traditional style yet also has contemporary touches and quirky (in a good way!) artwork. There's a bright and airy feel to the chalet and it's also in a great spot towards the lower end of the village, with easy access to the wonderful Aquamotion.

title: Chalet Ecureuil - Courchevel
name: Chalet Ecureuil
tagline: Smart alpine chalet for 8-10 guests
offers: 2026/27 free places offer available!
Get a half free place when you book the whole chalet
paras: New to Le Ski for the coming season, it is far easier to describe this pretty, detached, chalet than it is to pronounce its name in French! Ecureuil des Neiges (pronounced “ay-cue-roy-day-nej”) to give it its full name (literally meaning Snow Squirrel in English) is another classic Alpine chalet with a pitched slate roof and a wonderful mix of local stone and wood, both internally and externally. Its office nickname is Squirrel so please feel free to call it that when booking!

The chalet’s spacious, warm and cosy top floor lounge area has a double height wooden ceiling with French windows opening onto the South-West facing balcony. From here you can admire the wonderful views of the Courchevel valley – perfect for watching the sunset with a glass of pre-dinner Le Ski Champagne and canapés! The charming owners have decorated the chalet beautifully with artwork, photos and cushions creating a pleasant, welcoming atmosphere. There is also a very practical and well-equipped ski room.

Ecureuil des Neiges is a very versatile chalet which suits groups of 8 to 10 guests. There are 5 bedrooms in total, 4 of which are ensuite. The dining table would be tight for 10 adults so we recommend the 9th and 10th beds for children who would have an early dinner. Feel free to call us to discuss your group’s needs and we can run through the chalet with you.

Located in a peaceful spot six minutes’ walk below the village, the chalet is also close to the escalator which arrives straight into the village centre. The lifts and shops can also be accessed by bus if you prefer. The amazing Aquamotion is just a short walk down the hill. It sits very near to our Premier de Cordée, Notus and Bisolet chalets.
We look forward to hearing you try to pronounce the chalet name when you call to book! Or avoid any embarrassment and book online!
summary: Charming traditional style chalet

There is one large ensuite twin for 2 guests and one room with 2 sets of full size, specially commissioned, oak bunks which can sleep 4 and has its own private bathroom. Guests in this room receive £100 off per person from full price holidays.

Chalet L'Eterlou can be used in conjunction with any other chalet in the Lodge for larger groups. Please note that to enjoy watching your favourite shows on the TV here in this chalet please bring an HDMI cable to fit your device, an Amazon Fire stick or anything else.

This summer lots has been going on in the lounge and dining area. The owner has commissioned some stunning original artwork and a fabulous new, specially built dining table.

The bright and spacious lounge has been beautifully decorated and if you do get bored of the artworks the views up and down the Courchevel valley from the huge balcony are pretty stunning. The picture windows make dinner here an absolute treat.
There are now five twin bedrooms, all fully ensuite. They do range in size so please ask our UK staff for advice.

An interesting feature of Chalet Golden Eagle is its separate media room on the ground floor, away from the lounge. This room has a DVD player as well as access to channels you'd find on a typical Smart TV, such as Netflix - don't forget to bring your log in details!
Golden Eagle is next door to its sister chalet Eagle's Nest and the two chalets can be booked together.

title: Chalet Irma - Courchevel
name: Chalet Irma
tagline: Stylish chalet for 6 in great location with steam room
paras: Chalet Irma was built on the site of "The Shack", where one of our directors lived in the 1980s, when health and safety was unknown in the French Alps (one plug socket and a dodgy tepid shower...). The idea that it is now a smart, stylish chalet with a steam room is simply incredible! But it's true...
Chalet Irma is in a perfect position just 3 minutes walk from the main lift station in Courchevel Moriond yet hidden away in a very peaceful spot with far reaching views up and down the valley.

Irma is named after a family member of the owners and is a very well designed chalet. It sleeps 6 in 3 fully ensuite bedrooms. The cosy lounge and dining areas with wood burning stove are on the top floor (look out for the low beams up here!) from where the views are really beautiful. The ground floor is home to a fabulous hammam and heated boot room.

Chalet Irma has proved extremely popular with our guests since it was built for the 2016-17 season. It is a fabulous mixture of classic and contemporary styles with fabulous facilities. In short, it's a beauty and you won't be disappointed.
As this chalet has a smart TV, you can enjoy your favourite shows by simply logging in to your streaming app of choice and clicking play!

La Terrasse has two bedrooms and two bathrooms and sleeps four guests. Its lounge and dining areas are very comfortable, bright and spacious and are beautifully finished in contemporary style. New for December 2023 are some smart dining chairs to replace the benches seen in the current dining room imagery.

La Terrasse was named for its huge outdoor area accessed through the large French windows. It offers s tunning views of the slopes of both 1850 and 1550 aswell as the beautiful sunsets over the valley down below.
The two bedrooms are both stylishly decorated: the master bedroom has a bath/shower, WC and basin, with a terrace, and the 2 nd bedroom has ensuite shower, and basin, with WC opposite.
Chalet La Terrasse is a great venue for family and friends to enjoy a private chalet party. Le Ski also run Chalet Bellevue, for four guests, in the same building.

title: Chalet Le Bisolet - Courchevel
name: Chalet Le Bisolet
tagline: Sleeps 7 guests - great views, stylish decor and a rare single room
paras: Chalet Le Bisolet is a beautful chalet for seven guests with three ensuite twins plus a single room which carries no sole occupancy fee. The chalet's private sauna is also a very welcome bonus.

This lovely chalet is owned by a charming local family who live nearby. In case you didn't know Bisolet is a French slang word meaning a "kiss of cold wind". Fear not, the chalet is far nicer than that awkward translation implies...

Bisolet's top floor lounge and dining area has some of the best views in the valley and the sunsets from the balcony can be truly spectacular. Once the sun has set most guests sit and watch the roaring flames of the attractive open log fireplace, usually with complimentary Champagne and canapes in hand. Rumour has it that Bisolet has Le Ski's most comfortable sofas...

The three twin bedrooms all have ensuite bathrooms, while the single room has its own private shower and wc across the corridor. For ultimate relaxation, guests love the relaxing sauna, and appreciate the very comfy leather sofas.

Le Bisolet is near to the escalator which takes guests up to the village centre. Alternatively it's a six minute walk or a short bus ride. Guests are welcome to leave their equipment in our recommended ski hire shop overnight.

title: Chalet Le Mollard - Courchevel
name: Chalet Le Mollard
tagline: A stylish alpine chalet in the perfect location for 10 guests
paras: The exterior of Le Mollard suggests a classic Alpine chalet; the interior is more beachside home - and a very chic one at that. There's a wooden outdoor hot tub with stunning views, beautiful new sofas surrounding the log burner in the very comfortable lounge and a separate TV room in which to chill. Mollard is the perfect chalet for a group of friends or family to spend a week together and let everyone do their own thing - there are more sofas here than in some furniture stores and everything is geared to relaxation and comfort.

Le Mollard is also perfectly placed, next door to fellow Le Ski Chalet Irma, just 3 minutes walk from the centre of Courchevel Moriond. There is a very handy ski room with its own separate entrance, boot warmers and plenty of extra ski gear storage.

Unusually for a Le Ski chalet, not all bedrooms in Le Mollard are ensuite (there are five bedrooms and four bathrooms in total) hence it suits group of 8-10 best and can only be booked in its entirety on most dates. Two double rooms have full ensuite facilities and one has private facilities. The last 2 rooms are very flexible - one is a bunk room which can be used as a single with no sole occupancy charge and the other has a double bed but can also be used as a single with no extra charge. Please note this last room also has access to the outdoor hot tub.
Le Mollard has been designed and decorated with style and warmth and we are sure this funky chalet will soon become another of our regular guests' favourites.
Lower Ground Floor: Double/twin with private shower and WC. Double with bath, handheld shower and WC.
Ground floor: Large lounge and dining areas, log fireplace, kitchen. Large balconies on all sides.

1st floor: Large double with bath, double sink and WC. Single room with no sole occupancy charge (can be used as a children's bunk room). Double room with no charge for sole occupancy (can be used as a double - access to hot tub is via this room).
As this chalet has a smart TV, you can enjoy your favourite shows by simply logging in to your streaming app of choice and clicking play!

title: Chalet Le Notus - Courchevel
name: Chalet Le Notus
tagline: Spacious, stylish chalet for 10 in a peaceful location
offers: 2026/27 free places offer available!

paras: Chalet Le Notus is an excellent choice for a group wanting complete privacy in one of our Courchevel chalets. It is beautifully decorated and wood clad throughout and the very spacious lounge has gorgeous leather sofas.

The bedrooms all have ensuite bathrooms with either a shower or a bath. The lounge and dining area has a stone fireplace and a huge West-facing terrace for admiring the incredible sunsets or watching the clouds build up to bring more snow.
The ground floor sauna is naturally very popular with guests requiring a spot of relaxation after a hard day on the hill.
Le Notus is owned by the same family as next door Chalet Le Bisolet and again has been named after a wind, this time a nice one! A Notus is a warm, moist wind emanating from the South of France.

Located close to the escalator which takes guests up to the village centre, guests of Chalet Le Notus will enjoy the peaceful location and can leave their equipment in the ski shop to make life easier in the mornings.
The fabulous Aquamotion is a short walk away - we highly recommend a visit. The village centre and lifts are a short bus journey or six minute uphill walk away.

paras: Premier de Cordée is a warm and welcoming chalet just made for relaxation after a tough day on the hill! Classic detached chalet exterior, modern Alpine interior with traditional touches and rustic timber panelling. Sunsets are a particular treat from the large picture windows in the West-facing lounge and dining areas.

The lovely local owner draws on her skills as an excellent school teacher to ensure that all is in tip top condition each season. Her meticulous attention to detail is much appreciated by our staff and guests, who often describe Premier de Cordee as the perfect chocolate box style of chalet.

The steam room is popular for post ski pampering, followed by an aperitif and natter with your chalet mates around the handsome log fireplace. All five bedrooms are fully ensuite, the largest of which can easily accommodate three guests.

Premier de Cordée is situated on the edge of the village ensuring a peaceful night, yet it's just below the main road where you’ll find the escalator which takes you quickly to the village centre and main ski lifts. Aquamotion is a short walk away and a visit is very highly recommended.
As well as the escalator, guests can use the regular free bus or take a six minute walk to get to the village centre. There is also a boot warmer for those bringing equipment back to the chalet.

tagline: Newly improved fabulous piste side chalet for 22 guests

paras: We are delighted that the owners of this fabulous chalet made a lot of important improvements to the Chalet Rikiki we all know and love last Autumn. In the lounge new sofas, new armchairs and new coffee tables have made a big difference. In the bedrooms there are new headboards and new bedside tables and in the entrance hall new benches and ski storage.

A week in Rikiki is what we believe chalet holidays are all about: great piste-side location, comfortable ensuite bedrooms and a lively atmosphere with likeminded people sharing stories around the dinner table!
Our largest chalet in Courchevel, Rikiki is close to the nursery slopes and was built to a superb modern design, giving all 12 bedrooms ensuite bathroom facilities with either bath or shower.

The double height ceiling makes the lounge and dining area bright and spacious, especially as the French windows open onto a large piste-side terrace. A large open log fireplace adds to the cosy atmosphere in the lounge.

The chalet was built - and is still owned by - a local family with the classic mix of winter time ski instructors and summertime builders. They clearly have a sense of humour too - Rikiki is enormous but in French slang it means "absolutely tiny".
To access the pistes, grab your skis from the boot room and walk up the side of the chalet, across the snow and you’ll be on the nursery slope less than a minute's ski to the main lift.
You can also ski back right onto the terrace of Rikiki and you could even get straight into the hot tub - but we'd recommend changing out of your ski gear first...
Rikiki really is the perfect Alpine chalet, which is why it is always booked so far in advance! Get in here while you can.

Le Corty's sister Chalet Serenia will be finished this Summer and we will get photographs online as soon as we can after that. They will be identical in finish so you will be able to see the style the owners have used. It is going to be a beauty!

title: Chalet Azel - Val d'Isere
name: Chalet Azel
tagline: Stunning chalet for 8 guests
paras: We are so pleased to show off one of our newest properties in Val d'Isere, Chalet Azel. It is the brainchild of the same family who built our most beautiful chalet, La Belle Etoile and was built it in an environmentally friendly fashion - as far as is possible in the Alps. Azel (named after one of the family) lies below Belle Etoile, near the eponymous river Isere, and is a very short walk from the bus stop which will take you either to La Daille or the Bellevarde Express.

The trees which had to be chopped down to make way for the chalet have been used throughout the building - some are window sills, some are exterior cladding, etc. There is an air source heat pump which uses already heated air to help heat the water. The family also plant new trees every year to replace those felled. All in all it's a pretty cool chalet!

The very spacious and comfortable lounge and dining areas have a welcoming log fireplace and huge picture windows on 3 sides as well as a large terrace. Everything about Chalet Azel is top quality, from the triple glazing to the fixtures and fittings to the beds and pillows.

All the bedrooms are spacious and have their own ensuite bathroom with walk in shower and separate wc. There is an outdoor hot tub on Azel's balcony and a sauna on the ground floor of the building for the exclusive use of Le Ski guests. There is also a heated boot room and a ski store.
Chalet Azel is situated on the opposite side of the road to our own Cacholet chalets and it's a 2 minute walk to the nearest bus stop which takes you to the main lifts.

paras: Chalet Roc Merlet was the last of our Cacholet chalets to be transformed - something we did during lockdown as we couldn't leave resort! We have totally refurbished and redesigned the beautiful lounge and dining area of Roc Merlet and it's probably the best of our Cacholet chalets now. The fabulous high ceilings here really add to the feeling of space in these very spacious lounge and dining areas. During summer 2023 we have stripped every square inch of external woodwork back to the original, much lighter colour and oiled it to protect from the sun and snow. We hope you enjoy our new "old" look...

It has a large yet cosy living area with beautiful beams in those high ceilings, traditional-style wooden and stone walls and large balcony windows letting in lots of natural light. This spacious living area feels wonderfully atmospheric with the log fire and is the perfect space for socialising.
Each of the bedrooms has a contemporary ensuite bathroom with bath, shower, wc and basin. Each room also has a balcony and plenty of storage.
Part of our group of ‘Cacholet’ chalets Roc Merlet overlooks the courtyard and our fabulous two shared outdoor hot tubs, in which guests can relax in style after a day on the hill.
Roc Merlet guests can use our comprehensive new shuttle service to and from the slopes in the morning and evening.
Alternatively the main village is a short journey on the shuttle from the nearby bus stop, or a nine minute walk.
